verdict.rationale: Azure ships strong declarative IaC (ARM templates, Bicep DSL) and documented Terraform support/export as first-party-adjacent tooling, satisfying the 'templates' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of a typed CDK-style programming framework (like AWS CDK) for Azure, and no documentation cited on state file management or deployment rollback semantics for these tools. Missing for 10: a first-party typed CDK-style framework, and documented state/rollback semantics for deployments.
